_doc: Which cases in cases.json need your server's own policy rather than the drafts, and where the drafts disagree. Every case not listed is 'draft': its status and problem type are fixed by draft-ietf-wimse-http-signature-08 s3.6 and the WIT/identifier drafts. Read by peers/driver.py. cases.json stays the single source of expected outcomes.

policy.IN6: issuer allowlist: the trust domain is trusted but the WIT iss http://other.ietf127.example must be refused; needs a per-trust-domain issuer allowlist
policy.C12: issuer allowlist: iss http://127.0.0.1:47999/jwks.json must be refused without fetching it; needs an issuer allowlist and no JWKS fetch from iss
policy.C12b: same as C12 for trust domain lax.ietf127.example (trusted keys, no issuer allowlist); expects 400 or 403 and no fetch
policy.A13i: needs a grant for wimse://peer.ietf127.example/a~b (the case sends a%7Eb in a mixed-case host and expects it to match)
policy.A13j: needs a grant for wimse://peer.ietf127.example/a/b and none for the escaped a%2Fb; expects 403 (not-authorized)
policy.IN15: needs a grant table: wimse://peer.ietf127.example/ungranted must be authenticated but refused with 403

draft_conflict._doc: Cases whose cases.json outcome (401 + WWW-Authenticate: WPT) follows draft-ietf-wimse-wpt-02 s2.1 (SHOULD 401), while draft-ietf-wimse-http-signature-08 s3.6 says 400 wimse-signature-invalid and 401 is NOT RECOMMENDED. In --wire-only mode only, the alternative below is accepted too, and the output says which one matched. Journal mode (Maurice) never uses it.

A5.label: draft (wpt-02 SHOULD 401; conflicts with http-signature-08, which defines no error for an unsigned request and recommends 400 for failed signed requests)

IN13.label: draft (wpt-02 SHOULD 401; conflicts with http-signature-08 s3.6: 400 wimse-signature-invalid, 401 NOT RECOMMENDED)
